mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN enable = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS enabled, SUM(CASE WHEN next_trigger_time < #{now} AND enable = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending, SUM(CASE WHEN enable = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS disabled FROM user_scheduled_common_task

SELECT * FROM user_scheduled_common_task WHERE 1 = 1
AND task_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{taskName}, '%')
AND biz_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{bizName}, '%')
ORDER BY next_trigger_time ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
